claims.quote: Hoplisoma kanei, long known as Corydoras kanei, is an armoured catfish that appears to be native to the rio Negro basin in Brazil, possibly only the rio Branco drainage.
Type locality is 'Aquarium specimen, said to be from Brazil, Roraima State near Boa Vista, possibly from the Rio Branco'.
